name: Run the WebGL check from the header and measure again (signed in)
description: Validates /diagnostics, reached from the header's WebGL check link: the map probe renders, the 3D seabed probe names its renderer and times its frames, and Measure again runs a fresh measurement.

planSteps.description: In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Click "WebGL check" (data-testid diagnostics-link) at the right of the header
Assert the URL path is /diagnostics and the page heading reads "Diagnostics"
Wait up to 60 seconds for the map probe (data-testid map-probe) to reach data-state "rendered" and the 3D seabed probe (data-testid scene-probe) to reach data-state "measured"
Assert the map status (data-testid map-status) reads "Map rendered" and its first render (data-testid map-first-render) is a number of ms

Assert the seabed status (data-testid scene-status) reads "Measured", the renderer (data-testid scene-renderer) is not empty, frames per second (data-testid scene-fps) is a number above 0, and frames timed (data-testid scene-frame-count) is a whole number above 0
Click "Measure again" (data-testid scene-measure-again) and wait up to 60 seconds for the scene probe to reach data-state "measured" again
Assert the seabed status reads "Measured" again and frames timed is a whole number above 0
